operation_details.item: The user uses paid search as one of their acquisition channels.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Let's outline the acquisition plan for the next campaign and clarify which channels are currently in use.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use organic social as an acquisition channel.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How are you incorporating direct audience communication into the campaign mix?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use email as an acquisition channel.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Which other acquisition options should we include when reviewing the channel plan?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use paid search as one of my acquisition channels.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives us several channels to compare. Where do you review their results?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I track channel performance in the growth dashboard.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: We can use that view to organize the campaign discussion around acquisition activity and performance reporting.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That will help keep the planning conversation focused on the channels and reporting process.
